methods.name: GeoState
methods.description: A view-decoupled geometry representation for predictive 3D world modeling that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation.

methods.name: Scene Tokenizer
methods.description: A component of GeoState that aggregates multi-view GFM features into a view-decoupled scene state.

methods.name: Geometry Decoder
methods.description: A component of GeoState that queries the scene state using camera rays to reconstruct geometry.

methods.name: Autoregressive World Model
methods.description: A component of GeoState that predicts future scene states autoregressively.

methods.name: Camera Prediction Model
methods.description: An optional model that predicts future camera motion.

methods.name: Perceiver-style Tokenizer
methods.description: A type of tokenizer used within the Scene Tokenizer for aggregating features.

methods.name: Query Transformer
methods.description: A component within the Geometry Decoder that processes scene and ray tokens.

methods.name: Feature Decoder
methods.description: A component within the Geometry Decoder that maps view-conditioned representations to feature levels for the GFM head.

methods.name: Masked Factorized Transformer
methods.description: The architecture adopted for the Autoregressive World Model.

methods.name: VGGT-Ω
methods.description: A frozen geometry foundation model used as a backbone to extract geometry-aware features.

methods.name: VGGT-Ω dense prediction head
methods.description: A frozen component of VGGT-Ω reused by the Geometry Decoder for depth prediction.

datasets.name: Waymo
datasets.description: A large-scale dataset of dynamic driving scenes used for in-domain evaluation.

datasets.name: KITTI
datasets.description: A dataset used for zero-shot transfer evaluation.

datasets.name: nuScenes
datasets.description: A dataset used for zero-shot transfer evaluation.

metrics.name: Llog D
metrics.description: Mean absolute log-depth error, used to measure geometry reconstruction accuracy.

metrics.name: Lgrad
metrics.description: Local depth gradients, used to supervise local depth consistency.

concepts.name: View-decoupled geometry representation
concepts.description: A representation that separates scene dynamics from camera-induced variation.

concepts.name: Geometry foundation models (GFMs)
concepts.description: Models that learn rich geometric representations from RGB observations, providing strong geometric priors.

concepts.name: Predictive 3D world modeling
concepts.description: The task of representing and predicting future environments in geometrically grounded state spaces.

concepts.name: Scene-state evolution
concepts.description: The genuine physical changes occurring in a 3D scene over time.

concepts.name: Camera-induced variation
concepts.description: Changes in a representation caused by camera viewpoint changes, not actual scene dynamics.

concepts.name: Context-derived scale
concepts.description: A consistent scale maintained throughout the rollout without per-frame alignment.

concepts.name: Viewpoint coupling
concepts.description: The entanglement of scene dynamics with camera-induced variation in GFM features.

concepts.name: Scene content
concepts.description: The intrinsic geometric and semantic information of a scene.

concepts.name: Scene observation
concepts.description: How a scene is perceived from a specific camera viewpoint.

concepts.name: Geometric priors
concepts.description: Pre-learned knowledge about geometric structures and relationships.

concepts.name: Multi-view RGB observations
concepts.description: Images captured from multiple camera viewpoints.

concepts.name: Geometry-aware features
concepts.description: Features extracted by GFMs that encode geometric information.

concepts.name: Shared scene coordinate system
concepts.description: A common reference frame for representing multi-view geometry.

concepts.name: Common anchor view
concepts.description: A specific view used to define a shared coordinate frame across timestamps.

concepts.name: Fixed-length scene state
concepts.description: A compact representation of a scene with a consistent size, independent of the number of source views.

concepts.name: Query camera
concepts.description: A specified camera viewpoint from which to decode scene geometry.

concepts.name: Depth map
concepts.description: An image representing the distance of surfaces from the camera.

concepts.name: Autoregressive prediction
concepts.description: A method of predicting future states based on a sequence of past states.

concepts.name: Scene dynamics
concepts.description: The temporal changes and movements within a 3D scene.

concepts.name: Scene persistence
concepts.description: The property that the underlying scene geometry remains consistent unless physically changed.

concepts.name: Residual update
concepts.description: A method where future states are predicted as an additive change to the current state.

concepts.name: Plücker ray field
concepts.description: A representation of camera rays used in geometry decoding.

concepts.name: Fourier-encoded
concepts.description: A technique for encoding spatial information, applied to Plücker ray fields.

concepts.name: View-conditioned representations
concepts.description: Representations that incorporate information about the query viewpoint.

concepts.name: Metric depth
concepts.description: Depth values expressed in real-world units.

concepts.name: Geometry reconstruction
concepts.description: The process of recovering 3D geometric information from observations.

concepts.name: Novel-view querying
concepts.description: The ability to generate observations from viewpoints not seen during encoding.

concepts.name: Target-state construction
concepts.description: The process of creating ground truth future GeoStates for supervision.

concepts.name: Future supervision
concepts.description: Ground truth data used to train the world model for future prediction.

concepts.name: Growing observation prefixes
concepts.description: A method for constructing target GeoStates by feeding increasing sequences of observations into the GFM.

findings.name: GeoState outperforms prior 3D world models on Waymo
findings.description: GeoState achieved better depth forecasting performance on the Waymo dataset compared to existing 3D world models.

findings.name: GeoState supports geometrically consistent cross-view querying
findings.description: GeoState can generate consistent geometric reconstructions from different viewpoints.

findings.name: GeoState generalizes zero-shot to KITTI
findings.description: GeoState performs well on the KITTI dataset without specific training on it.

findings.name: GeoState generalizes zero-shot to nuScenes
findings.description: GeoState performs well on the nuScenes dataset without specific training on it.

findings.name: GeoState maintains consistent scale throughout forecasting rollout
findings.description: GeoState avoids the need for per-frame scale alignment during temporal prediction.

findings.name: View decoupling makes scene representation more predictable
findings.description: Separating viewpoint dependence from the scene state simplifies temporal modeling.

findings.name: View-decoupled geometry states are effective for predictive 3D world modeling
findings.description: The proposed GeoState representation is well-suited for forecasting 3D world evolution.

findings.name: GeoState separates scene content from scene observation
findings.description: GeoState explicitly disentangles the intrinsic scene properties from how they are viewed.

findings.name: GeoState enables long-horizon geometry forecasting
findings.description: GeoState can predict scene geometry accurately over extended future time steps.
